comment: Dichlorination of an aminoacyl-S-carrier substrate (pyrrolyl-S-PltL)in the pyoluteorin pathway. Flavin reductase is not encoded in pyolteorin genecluster. SsuE was used instead. Concentration-dependent Br possible. Stereochemistry could not be depicted due to incompatibility with validation engine.

reactions.description: Initial chlorination of position 5 followed by 4 of pyrrolyl-S-PltL complex yielding 4,5-dichloropyrrolyl-S-PltL
Initial bromination of position 5 followed by 4 of pyrrolyl-S-PltL complex yielding 4,5-dichloropyrrolyl-S-PltL
